deadline_text: No application dates are posted for summer 2027. The page lists 2026 home bases only.

name: Girls Inc. Eureka! STEM program (YWCA Minneapolis)
org: Girls Inc. at YWCA Minneapolis, with University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering
what_you_do: Join a five year STEM program. It has summer camp at the University of Minnesota and YWCA Midtown, plus school year support. You explore STEM careers and meet mentors. In high school you can do a stipend internship.
grades: Grades 8 to 12 (the University of Minnesota page says students entering grades 8 and 9 can apply)
pay_detail: Eureka! interns get a stipend from Girls Inc. after completing a 4 week internship (20 hours a week). The amount is not stated. The cost of the summer program is not stated on the page.
duration: Summer camp about 4 weeks (2026: June 29 to July 24), Mon to Thu 8:45 a.m. to 4 p.m. and Fri to 2 p.m.
deadline_text: The 2026 summer dates were June 29 to July 24, 2026 (no camp July 4). The page says registration is currently closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Minneapolis Parks Teen Teamworks
what_you_do: Do work experiences with the Park Board. They teach work skills, decision making, communication and a good work ethic. Photo captions on the page show crews doing garden, painting and sign install projects.
pay_detail: The page lists this under Youth Employment and Training Initiatives but does not say whether Teen Teamworks is paid or give a pay rate. Ask the Park Board.
duration: Not stated (the page only mentions a '2026 season')
deadline_text: The page says applications for the 2026 season are closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Minneapolis Park Board Youth Advisory Council
what_you_do: Serve on a youth council. It gives feedback on Park Board programs and processes. Members plan community events and build leadership and research skills. They explore careers. They help guide anti-violence outreach.
pay_detail: Pay is not stated on the page. The page says members get support with professionalism, financial literacy and customer service.
duration: Two year term, 5 to 12 hours a month
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the council page.

name: Discover STEM (University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering)
org: University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering Student Services
what_you_do: Spend one week on the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus. You learn about current research and careers. You see talks and lab tours. You see science experiments and technology demos. You join Q&A sessions.
pay_detail: The page says there is no cost to apply and attend, thanks to 3M. It also mentions an enrollment fee or scholarship request after admission, so confirm that nothing is charged.
duration: 1 week, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. daily (day program)
deadline_text: Summer 2026: sessions were Aug 3 to 7 and Aug 10 to 14, 2026. Applications were open April 20 to May 18, 2026 and decisions went out by May 29. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Walker Art Center Teen Arts Council (WACTAC)
what_you_do: Meet weekly during the school year with teens from across the Twin Cities. You connect with contemporary art and artists. You learn how an art center works. You help create programs for other teens.
pay_detail: Pay or stipend is not stated on the page.
duration: Weekly meetings during the school year
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 school year have closed. Applications for 2027-28 will open in spring 2027.

name: Summer VolunTEEN Program
what_you_do: You volunteer in hospital and clinic areas. Examples are patient transport, radiology and discharge. You work 1 to 2 four-hour shifts per week.
duration: 8-week program, 6-week minimum (2026: June 15 to Aug 7)
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application completion deadline May 4, 2026 (first come, first served). 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: UC Davis Medical Microbiology and Immunology high school research internship
org: UC Davis School of Medicine with DJUSD and Esparto CTE
what_you_do: This is a 10-week spring program. It meets on Tuesday afternoons. You learn lab safety. You learn to use pipettes, which are tools that measure small amounts of liquid. You watch lab demonstrations and try 3D printing. You visit the Center for Valley Fever.
pay_detail: The DJUSD CTE page says its internships are unpaid. The UC Davis article does not mention pay.
duration: 10 weeks (2025 cohort: Mar 18 to May 22)
deadline_text: 2026-27 cohort not confirmed. Last known cohort ran Mar 18 to May 22, 2025.

name: Summer at UC Davis Pre-College Program
org: UC Davis Continuing and Professional Education
what_you_do: You spend two weeks on the UC Davis campus studying a subject you pick, such as pre-med, forensics, equine science or startup entrepreneurship. You live in a UC Davis dorm.
pay_detail: 2025 tuition was $6,985 plus a $100 application fee (includes dorm and meals). 2027 price not posted yet.
duration: about 2 weeks per session (2025: July 7 to 18 and July 21 to Aug 1)
deadline_text: 2025 cycle deadline was May 16, 2025 (the fee page still shows 2025). 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: UC Davis Upward Bound
what_you_do: You get free college-prep help during the school year, plus a summer program on the UC Davis campus.
pay_detail: No fee listed on the page. Confirm with the program.
duration: school year plus summer
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Check with an Upward Bound advisor at your school.

name: Young Scholars Program (YSP)
what_you_do: You spend six weeks living on campus in a summer program. You work in a UC Davis lab with a faculty mentor on a real project and write a research paper.
pay_detail: 2026 program cost $7,750 (housing, meals and 5 units of credit included). Application fee $45 in 2026. Fee reduction and application fee waiver available.
duration: 6 weeks (2026 dates: June 21 to Aug 1)
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications Jan 1 to Mar 1, 2026, teacher references by Mar 3. 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: UC Scout Online High School Courses
what_you_do: You can take UC-approved online high school and AP courses at your own pace.
pay_detail: Fees vary by course and prices are not on the home page. The site lists free options for California public schools and scholarships. The page does not say anyone is paid.
duration: Self-paced
deadline_text: Fall 2026 enrollment is open (as of Oct 7, 2026).

name: COSMOS at UC Irvine (California State Summer School for Mathematics and Science)
what_you_do: You live on campus for four weeks. You take a hands-on, lab-heavy STEM course. It is called a cluster. Faculty, researchers and scientists teach it.
pay_detail: Fee-based residential program. The 2027 cost is not stated on UCI's page, so check the COSMOS site for the current fee.
duration: 4 weeks, residential (2027 session dates TBA)
deadline_text: Statewide COSMOS dates: application opens Jan 6, 2027 at 8:00 AM and closes Feb 5, 2027. Financial aid forms postmarked by Feb 6, 2027. Decisions Mar 25, 2027. UCI's own pages still show 2026 dates, so confirm there.

name: UCI Health High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You volunteer one weekly three-hour shift at UCI Medical Center. It is for students who think about a medical career. It is also for students who like helping others.
pay_detail: Unpaid.
duration: One 3-hour shift a week, Monday to Friday 4 to 7 p.m., minimum 75 hours
deadline_text: Volunteer applications are currently closed. The page says it is under construction and will be back soon, with no date.

name: UCLA Health Westwood High School Summer Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help patients and visitors at the hospital. Tasks include moving patients, helping people find their way at entrances and wheelchair help. You can also deliver patient mail and newspapers.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Parking is not free for student volunteers.
duration: At least 50 hours, finished by August 31
deadline_text: The page says the High School Summer Program is now closed. Information for Summer 2027 will be posted starting January 1, 2027. Hours must be done by August 31.

name: UCLA Summer Sessions for high school students
what_you_do: Take UCLA college courses in the summer, either alongside UCLA undergraduates or in a 3-week focused program (engineering, economics, politics, architecture and more). Earn UCLA credit.
pay_detail: Fee-based. Ask UCLA Summer Sessions for current fees. Scholarship programs described on the page include BASE and Summer Scholars Support.
duration: Focus Series: 3 weeks; other formats vary (2026 sessions ran June 22 to July 31)
deadline_text: Summer 2026 enrollment is closed. Summer 2027 programs and dates are not posted yet; the site offers a sign-up for 2027 updates.

name: UCR TRIO Pre-College: Upward Bound and Educational Talent Search
what_you_do: This is free college prep support. It includes tutoring, advising, SAT prep and college visits. Upward Bound has a six-week summer program at UCR. It comes with a stipend.
pay_detail: Free to join. Only Upward Bound summer participants receive a stipend (amount not stated).
duration: Year-round support; UB summer program is 6 weeks (5 weeks bused to campus, final week in residence halls)
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Apply with the interest form or ETS application.

name: COSMOS at UC San Diego
org: UC San Diego (Jacobs School of Engineering) / California State Summer School for Mathematics and Science
what_you_do: This is a four-week residential summer program. Motivated math and science students take a hands-on cluster course. They pick the topic. It is on the UCSD campus.
pay_detail: 2026 program cost $5,518 (housing, meals, field trips) plus a $46 application fee. Financial assistance form available for California residents. Amounts for 2027 not posted.
duration: 4 weeks (2026: July 5 to July 31)
deadline_text: 2027 applications open Jan 6, 2027 at 8 a.m. and close Feb 5, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. The program says no exceptions to the deadline.

name: Sports Medicine Summer Academy (Research Scholars)
org: UC San Diego Division of Extended Studies
what_you_do: This is a three-week daytime course. It covers sports injuries, anatomy and care. You do hands-on skills like taping and wound care. You do a small research project with wearable tech.
pay_detail: $3,500 for the July 2026 session (commuter only; no housing or transportation). A hybrid fall session cost $2,000.
duration: 3 weeks, weekdays 9:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. (2026: July 6 to July 24)
deadline_text: 2026 summer enrollment closed June 26, 2026; fall 2026 enrollment closed Sept 21, 2026. Summer 2027 dates not posted; you can sign up for notifications on the program page.

name: UCSF Health Volunteer Program (includes BCH Oakland campus)
org: UCSF Health / UCSF Benioff Children's Hospitals
city: Oakland, CA (BCH Oakland) and San Francisco
what_you_do: You can do non-medical volunteer work at a hospital. You visit and talk with patients. You do light office work. You help patients and visitors find their way. There is no shadowing, research or internships.

deadline_text: Page update dated Sept 22 (year not stated): registration opens Tuesday Oct 13 at 9:30am only for two high-need SF programs. Other opportunities, including others at BCH Oakland, are listed as full.

grades: Finished sophomore year of high school (first time in the program)
name: Young Scholars Program (UGA College of Agricultural and Environmental Sciences)
org: University of Georgia, College of Agricultural and Environmental Sciences
city: Athens, Griffin or Tifton, GA (UGA campuses)
what_you_do: This is a paid summer research internship. Students work 30 hours a week on supervised research with a UGA faculty mentor. Then they present a poster at a research conference.
pay_detail: Described as a paid internship, 30 hours a week. The pay amount is not stated on the pages read.
duration: Five weeks (June 1 to July 7 on the page, plus a three day conference July 8 to 10). The page does not show the year.
deadline_text: Last cycle: application opened Nov 3, 2025 and closed Jan 23, 2026. The program page now says the application is closed for this cycle. Next cycle dates not posted.

grades: Rising high school seniors (going into senior year), Georgia students
name: Georgia Ready Summer Institute (UGA)
org: University of Georgia, Office of Academic and Community Engagement
what_you_do: This is a one week program living on the UGA campus. Students explore research and learn about entrepreneurship. They build public speaking skills. They tour research labs.
pay_detail: Free to attend. The pages say there is no cost and that housing and meals are included.
duration: One week, residential
deadline_text: The 2026 application is closed (the application page says the deadline passed). Dates for the next cycle are not posted. Contact oace@uga.edu for future application cycles.

name: ESTEEM/SER-Quest Summer Program
org: A. James Clark School of Engineering, University of Maryland (Center for Minorities in Science and Engineering)
what_you_do: This is a 4-week summer program for rising seniors. You commute. It focuses on research. You learn about UMD engineering, research mentoring and the college application process.
pay_detail: No cost to students selected (stated on the page). No stipend is stated.
duration: 4 weeks (Jul 7 to Jul 31 in 2026), commuters only
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application deadline Mar 29, 2026; teacher recommendations due Apr 9, 2026; program Jul 7 to Jul 31, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Terp Young Scholars
org: University of Maryland, College Park (Extended Studies)
what_you_do: You take one 3-credit University of Maryland course. It lasts three weeks in the summer. You can take it on campus or online. You learn alongside regular UMD undergraduates.
pay_detail: 2026 package fee: $1,791 campus option or $1,420 online option (3 credits, tuition and fees). Also a $75 application fee and a $275 program deposit that is credited to the bill. Partial scholarships, none above 30% of the package fee.
duration: 3 weeks (Jul 13 to Jul 31 in 2026)
deadline_text: Application window dates are not stated on this page. The page says the application for this year is currently closed.

name: Teen Counselor-in-Training (CIT) program
what_you_do: You help staff with Arboretum summer day camps and gardens. You are a role model for younger campers. You build leadership skills with training and adult mentors.
pay_detail: One-time $100 registration fee (orientation, training, t-shirt, certificate, supplies); financial aid available for students who qualify for free or reduced school lunch. CIT service is volunteer time.
duration: Flexible half or full days over the summer
deadline_text: Applications for 2026 are closed. The page says to check back in January 2027 for the next session; an info session is held each February and the 2026 orientation was June 12.

name: Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAV) Camp
org: University of Minnesota, Minnesota CAV program
what_you_do: This is a free one-week day camp. You see and try automated vehicles. You take field trips to companies that work on the technology. You learn from University of Minnesota researchers.
pay_detail: Free to attend; lunch is provided
duration: One week, day camp
deadline_text: Information about the 2027 camp will be available in early 2027.

name: National Summer Transportation Institute (NSTI)
org: University of Minnesota Center for Transportation Studies
what_you_do: This is a free two-week day camp. You take field trips around the Twin Cities. Trips visit an airport, transit sites and construction sites. You do lab activities. You build a model bridge. You also tour the University of Minnesota.
pay_detail: Free two-week day camp
duration: Two weeks, day camp
deadline_text: Dates and application instructions for the 2027 camp will be announced in early 2027.

name: Explore@UNC
what_you_do: This is a one-week, day-only college experience. It is on the UNC campus. You pick an academic track. You take part in classes and activities.
pay_detail: $625 per student per week (includes a $50 non-refundable registration and placement fee); some tracks may add a $25 activity fee; lunch and snacks included. Need-based aid for permanent NC residents who are rising seniors.
duration: 1 week. 2027 weeks: June 14-18, June 21-25, June 28-July 2, July 12-16. Commuter only, no residential option.
deadline_text: Pre-registration runs mid-December 2026 through mid-January 2027; placement notices early February 2027; financial aid paperwork due January 28, 2027.

duration: August to May
name: Union City Youth Commission
what_you_do: You speak for Union City teens to the City Council. You plan community events. You volunteer through the year. You also earn community service hours.
deadline_text: The page lists applications from February 1 to April 1, interviews in April and appointments in May. It gives no year, so treat this as last year's pattern.

name: U.S. Senate Page Program
what_you_do: You get a paid job on the Senate floor. You also work in offices. You attend the Senate Page School for one semester or the summer.
pay_detail: $35,360 per year, prorated
duration: Spring 2027 session: Jan 24 to June 4, 2027. Summer 2027 dates to be announced.
deadline_text: Padilla's office: opens Oct 13, 2026, closes Oct 26, 2026 for the Spring 2027 session.

name: United States Senate Youth Program
org: Hearst Foundations, with the California Department of Education
what_you_do: You spend one week in Washington, DC meeting Senators and officials. The program comes with a $12,500 college scholarship. Two students are chosen per state, and all trip costs are paid.
grades: Juniors and seniors (rising juniors and seniors may apply)
pay_detail: $12,500 college scholarship; travel, hotel and meals paid by the Hearst Foundations
duration: Washington Week March 6 to 13, 2027
deadline_text: California's deadline for the 2027 program is October 7, 2026. That date has passed. The next cycle is expected in fall 2027.

name: USC Summer Programs (pre-college)
org: University of Southern California, Summer Programs
what_you_do: Take one college-level course on USC's campus with college faculty. Choose from 20+ courses in many subjects and earn 3 units of elective credit on a USC transcript.
pay_detail: 2026 total for domestic students: $8,130 commuter or $11,570 residential. That adds tuition $7,401, course materials $300, program fee $325 and health center $104; residential adds $3,440 room and board. Also a $85 nonrefundable application fee and a $1,000 deposit that counts toward the total.
duration: Four weeks, 9 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. each class day (2026 classes began June 22)
deadline_text: 2026 deadlines were May 8 for domestic and March 13 for international applicants. 2027 dates and prices are not posted.

name: USC Viterbi Energy of STEM Summer Camp (free)
what_you_do: A free one-week summer camp with demos, hands-on projects and group work. Topics are physics, coding, energy and electronics. SoCalGas employees lead activities with USC staff and students.
pay_detail: Free to attend. No pay.
deadline_text: The 2026 application closed May 4, 2026 and applicants were told by the end of May. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: USS Hornet Museum Volunteer (ages 16 and up)
org: USS Hornet Sea, Air and Space Museum
what_you_do: Restore aircraft or the ship, work in the radio room, do outreach, or help visitors. Teens 16 and 17 work with an adult.
duration: Set weekly shifts, for example Wed and Sat 8:30 to noon (aircraft), Tue and Sat (ship), first Saturday monthly (radio)
deadline_text: Rolling

name: SEES (STEM Enhancement in Earth Science) Summer High School Intern Program
org: UT Austin Center for Space Research with NASA and the Texas Space Grant Consortium
what_you_do: Work in a team with NASA and aerospace experts on real mission data (Earth science, astronomy, engineering). Includes online modules, mentor-led projects, and a final virtual symposium; some interns attend two weeks on site at UT.
pay_detail: No stipend. Free for scholarship recipients and for virtual participation; paid participants pay $2,000 tuition (meals, housing, tours and local travel included, travel to Austin not included). Travel scholarships are available.
duration: Online work in June and July plus a 2-week on-site session in Austin (July 5-18 in 2026)
deadline_text: 2026 deadline: February 22, 2026 at 8:00 p.m. PT, no late applications. 2027 dates are not posted; the page says future funding is not guaranteed.

name: Longhorn Engineering Summer Camp (LESC)
org: Cockrell School of Engineering, The University of Texas at Austin
what_you_do: This is a four-day day camp for rising 8th and 9th graders. You hear talks from UT faculty and students. Then you do hands-on activities. The activities show how engineering connects to art, sports, medicine and sustainability.
pay_detail: $75 commitment fee for Austin participants, collected only after acceptance (day camp, no lodging)
duration: 4 days (Austin sessions June 8-11 and July 6-9 in 2026; both were full)
deadline_text: Registration for 2026 closed March 12, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: My Introduction to Engineering (MITE)
org: Cockrell School of Engineering, The University of Texas at Austin
what_you_do: This is a five-day residential summer camp for rising seniors. You live on campus. Your team does an engineering project and hands-on activities. You spend time with engineering students, faculty and alumni.
pay_detail: $200, paid only after acceptance (students stay in a campus residence hall)
duration: 5 days (June 21-25 and July 12-16 in 2026)
deadline_text: Applications for MITE 2026 closed March 1, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: UVA Advance Pre-College Program
org: University of Virginia Summer and Special Academic Programs
what_you_do: This is a four-week residential program on UVA's campus. Rising juniors and seniors take one core class and one elective. Classes give letter grades and six transferable credits. The program also has college readiness workshops.
pay_detail: The FAQ says the maximum aid package covers full tuition and fees for Virginia residents, which is $7,097 for 2026. The cost for other students and the full breakdown were not read. Small number of need-based aid packages.
duration: 4 weeks (2026: July 11 to August 7), residential
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application opened December 1; deadline March 1, 2026; teacher recommendation March 4; decisions March 31; accept by April 15. No 2027 dates posted yet.

name: UVA Health Junior Volunteer Summer Program
what_you_do: This is eight weeks of summer volunteering. It is at UVA Health's Charlottesville hospital. It is for high school students. You do a full-day training. You do at least 50 hours of service. There is an interview.
duration: 8 weeks (2026: June 8 to July 31); at least 50 hours, or one full weekday, with at least 6 weeks of service
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: interest form due February 20, 2026; info sessions February 25 and March 7, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Virginia 4-H
org: Virginia Cooperative Extension (Virginia Tech and Virginia State University)
city: Statewide, Virginia (a local Extension office in each area)
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club, camp or project and learn by doing. Leadership, citizenship and life skills are taught through projects, camps, and county, state and national events.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the page read. Ask your local Extension office.
duration: Year-round, ongoing
deadline_text: No single deadline. Clubs, camps and events set their own dates.

grades: Finished grade 11, with at least one semester of high school left
name: Virginia Boys State
org: The American Legion, Department of Virginia
city: Virginia (college campus; the 2026 session was the 83rd)
what_you_do: Spend a week in a pretend 51st state. Delegates join a party, run for office, work in city, county and state government, and hear speakers from real government.
pay_detail: Free to the delegate. The $600 program fee is paid by a sponsor such as an American Legion post, business or school group. Parents and students may not pay it.
duration: One week (the 2026 session ran June 21 to 27, 2026)
deadline_text: 2027 session dates and sign-up dates are not posted yet. The 2026 session ran June 21 to 27, 2026. Local American Legion posts pick delegates earlier in the school year.

grades: Finished grade 11, with at least one semester of high school left
name: Virginia Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Virginia
what_you_do: Spend a week in a model state government. Girls learn how Virginia government works by doing it, with elections, bills and daily sessions.
pay_detail: There is a delegate fee, but the amount is not stated on the page read. Fees are paid to the district registrar (the site lists April 15, 2027 for fees to reach registrars). Ask your district registrar about the cost and who may sponsor you.
duration: One week: Sunday June 20 to Friday June 25, 2027
deadline_text: 2027 session: June 20 to 25, 2027. The site lists April 15, 2027 for fees to reach district registrars, May 15, 2027 for all delegates registered, and June 1, 2027 for online forms. A date to apply to your local unit is not posted.

name: Virginia House of Delegates Page Program
org: Virginia House of Delegates, Clerk's Office
what_you_do: Work as a House Page for the whole 2027 legislative session in Richmond. Pages deliver documents and run errands. They help committees and the Clerk's Office. They also take part in leadership and civics training.
pay_detail: A paid position of about 40 hours a week. The program FAQ says pages get a weekly session expense payment (no taxes withheld) and a regular wage paid every two weeks (taxes withheld). Dollar amounts are not stated on the pages read.
duration: The 2027 session. The page says 7 weeks in odd-numbered years
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 session close Friday, Oct 16, 2026 at 3 p.m. Eastern. Selected pages are usually told by email before Thanksgiving.

name: Summer Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: This is the Summer Youth Volunteer Program. You volunteer at a VA facility. You can volunteer as an individual or as a group.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Free to join; volunteers over 100 hours can be considered for scholarships through community partners (2024 flyer).
duration: 6 weeks, Monday to Friday 8:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. (2024: June 17 to July 26)
deadline_text: The VA page says applications for the 2026 program closed April 24, 2026. The 2024 deadline was April 30. 2027 dates not posted.

name: Senate of Virginia Page Program
what_you_do: Serve as a Senate Page for a whole legislative session. Pages staff committee meetings and answer phones. They deliver bill copies and help visitors. They do leadership training and a community service project.
pay_detail: $340 a week before taxes plus a $225 a week non-taxed expense deposit (per diem). Rates can change. Families pay about $50 for an activity fee, uniform clothes and a binder, and get the student to Richmond.
duration: The whole legislative session: 46 calendar days in odd-numbered years and 60 calendar days (nine total weeks) in even-numbered years
deadline_text: The class of 2027 application closed Oct 1, 2026. The class of 2028 application opens July 1, 2027 and closes at 5 p.m. on Oct 1, 2027. Decisions usually come in mid-December.

grades: Entering 9th grade (freshman year) at least; still in high school the next fall
name: Virginia State Parks Youth Conservation Corps
org: Virginia Department of Conservation and Recreation, State Parks
what_you_do: Live in a bunkhouse at a state park for two weeks. You work on trail upkeep, small building projects and other conservation work. Park rangers lead evening programs and outdoor activities.
pay_detail: $750 stipend after you finish the two-week program. You may also get community service hours.
duration: Two weeks. 2027 sessions: June 20 to July 3, or July 11 to 24
deadline_text: 2027 applications open Jan 1, 2027 and close Mar 19, 2027 at 5 p.m. Interviews Mar 30 to Apr 8, offers Apr 16, 2027.

name: Civil Air Patrol cadets, Virginia Wing
city: Statewide, Virginia (squadrons from Winchester to Virginia Beach)
what_you_do: Cadets fly, learn to lead, hike, camp and get in shape. Teens meet weekly with a local squadron and can go to the wing's summer encampment.
pay_detail: Annual cadet dues are $45 for Virginia in CAP's dues table, which also says national dues went up $10 for FY27. Uniform costs are not stated on the pages read.
duration: Weekly squadron meetings all year
deadline_text: No deadline. You can join any time through a local squadron.

name: Valley Water Youth Commission
org: Valley Water (Santa Clara Valley Water District)
city: San Jose, CA (serves all Santa Clara County)
what_you_do: High school students from across Santa Clara County serve two-year terms on a youth commission for Valley Water. There are 21 seats, each appointed by one of the seven board members.
duration: 2-year term, up to 5 hours a month
deadline_text: The application is closed and will open again in Spring 2027. Fill out the interest form to be told.

name: Art Exchange (Vancouver Art Gallery and Arts Umbrella)
org: Vancouver Art Gallery with Arts Umbrella
what_you_do: This is a year-long visual arts program for young teens. You visit the Vancouver Art Gallery behind the scenes. You also take workshops there. Then you do studio projects at Arts Umbrella on Granville Island.
pay_detail: Free to students (full scholarship). Not a paid job.
duration: October 2026 to June 2027
deadline_text: Submissions for the 2026-27 program were due Tuesday, September 29, 2026 at 8 AM. Next cycle not posted.

grades: Aged 15 to 18 or entering Grades 10, 11 or 12 in fall 2026
name: Teen Art Group (Vancouver Art Gallery and Emily Carr University)
org: Vancouver Art Gallery with Emily Carr University of Art + Design
what_you_do: This is a weekly arts program. It moves between the Vancouver Art Gallery and Emily Carr University studios. At the Gallery, you hear talks from curators and artists. You build a portfolio.
pay_detail: Registration fee $555.90 (the page does not state the currency; likely Canadian dollars). Four full-tuition scholarships are available for Indigenous students or students facing financial barriers.
duration: Thursdays 4 to 7 PM, October 15, 2026 to February 11, 2027
deadline_text: Registration for fall 2026 is open (no closing date stated). The scholarship deadline was September 15, 2026.

name: Mini Med School: Inside the Human Body (BC Children's Hospital Research Institute)
what_you_do: You attend four evening sessions. They cover recent advances in health and medical research. You can go in person in Vancouver or online. If you attend all four, you can apply for a $1,000 CAD tuition scholarship.
pay_detail: No cost is listed on the page. Attending all sessions makes you eligible to apply for a scholarship with $1,000 CAD toward post-secondary tuition.
duration: 4 Thursday evenings, 6:30 to 8:00 p.m.
deadline_text: 2026 sessions are Nov 5, 12, 19 and 26, 2026. Registration for 2026 is closed and no waitlist is taken. A new round is not posted yet.

name: Pathways to Science (BC Children's Hospital Research Institute)
what_you_do: Join free online talks from researchers and health professionals about science and health careers. It is lecture style. Cameras and microphones stay off and you ask questions in the chat.
pay_detail: Free. You get a certificate of participation if you apply and attend 7 of the 10 sessions.
duration: 10 monthly online sessions, Sept 2026 to June 2027, about 1 hour each
deadline_text: Ten Monday sessions from Sept 2026 to June 2027 (Sept 21, 2026 is 6 to 7 p.m.; the others are 5 to 6 p.m.). No deadline is posted. You can sign up any time during the series until 1,000 students have applied.

name: Youth Employability Program (BGC South Coast BC)
what_you_do: This is an 8-week program. About four weeks are job skills workshops and certificate training. Certificates include First Aid, WHMIS, Superhost and Serving It Right. Then you get up to four weeks of paid work experience with a local employer.
pay_detail: Participants are paid to take part, with a completion bonus for finishing all 8 weeks. Amounts are not stated on the page. Free to join.
duration: 8 weeks per session
deadline_text: Sessions run every other month (the page gives Oct, Dec, Feb, Apr as examples) and recruiting starts one month before each start date. No events were listed when read.

name: Discovery Days in Health Sciences (BC Children's Hospital)
org: Canadian Medical Hall of Fame with BC Children's Hospital Research Institute
what_you_do: Spend one day at BC Children's Hospital Research Institute. You learn about careers in medicine, health science and research.
pay_detail: No registration fee. You or your school pay for transportation and any parking.
deadline_text: Friday, Nov 6, 2026. No student deadline is posted. Student sign-up opens about six weeks before event day (around late September 2026). School registration for fall events opens in Sept 2026, and student sign-up instructions are emailed to the contact teacher when registration opens.

grades: Grades 11 and 12 for the High School Work Experience placement
name: Science World Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteers support the science centre. You work a weekly 2 to 3 hour shift. You get training and recognition. Lower Mainland Grade 11 and 12 students can also do a High School Work Experience placement.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer.
duration: 100 hours minimum, one 2 to 3 hour shift per week
deadline_text: The core volunteer intake is closed; intake and training sessions are scheduled each year. No dates posted.

name: SFU Camps Volunteer
what_you_do: You help camp instructors run hands-on activities. The activities are for children and youth at SFU's Burnaby campus. You get leadership training. You write reflections. You go to career workshops.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Volunteers get volunteer hours, evaluations, confirmation letters and a reference request option.
duration: Minimum 2 weeks (at least 80 hours), consecutive or separate
deadline_text: 2026: online applications opened March 20 and closed April 20, 2026; interviews mid-May (in person); training late June. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: H.R. MacMillan Space Centre teen volunteer
what_you_do: You volunteer at Vancouver's space science centre. You welcome visitors. You help set up headsets. You keep visitor flow smooth for the summer Augmented Reality Experience. You get education and skills training.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer role. The page lists education and skills training and mentions telescope viewing on some evening shifts as a volunteer benefit.
duration: Not stated. The summer Augmented Reality role is weekly support.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. The page refers to "this summer" without a year.

name: Stanley Park Ecology Youth Volunteering
what_you_do: You remove invasive plants. You host visitors at the Nature House. You can walk the park as an EcoRanger. You can also help at EcoCamp. Environmental educators give training.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer. Volunteers can request a reference letter after 25 hours.
duration: Varies by role; many are seasonal
deadline_text: Varies by role: DIRT and Nature House Host take applications year-round when there is room; EcoRangers apply in May; EcoCamp Assistant applications open in February and May; EcoStewards is listed as open.

name: UBC Future Global Leaders (on campus)
org: UBC Extended Learning, University of British Columbia
what_you_do: Take a university-style academic course or mini school taught by UBC professors and instructors on the Vancouver campus, with workshops and social activities. You get a letter of completion.
pay_detail: 2026 fees listed in CAD: course $1,940 for Canadian students (including permanent residents) or $2,620 international; mini school $2,110 Canadian or $2,855 international. Optional residence add-on $2,650. A $500 deposit is due when you register. Fees can change. The President Bursary is for B.C. grade 11 students with financial need.
duration: 2 weeks per session
deadline_text: Summer 2027 sessions: July 5 to 16, July 19 to 30 and Aug 2 to 13, 2027. Residence registration deadlines (noon): May 21, June 4 and June 18, 2027. Commuter deadlines (noon): June 18, July 2 and July 16, 2027. Residence can close sooner if full. The page does not say when 2027 registration opens.

name: UBC Summer Science Program for Indigenous students
org: UBC Centre for Excellence in Indigenous Health, Faculty of Medicine
what_you_do: Spend one week on the UBC campus. You do cultural, health and science workshops. Examples are drum-making, a virtual reality medicine lab and Talking Circles led by Elders. You also meet Indigenous mentors in health and science.
pay_detail: $200 program fee covers housing and meals. Workshops and Vancouver Aquarium admission are covered. Bursaries for students with financial need and travel bursaries are available. Travel to Vancouver is not included.
duration: 1 week
deadline_text: The 2026 application deadline was June 15, 2026. The program page for 2025 listed Week 1 as Aug 3 to 9 and Week 2 as Aug 10 to 16, with applications closing June 1. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Museum Teen Internship (Summer Service Program)
what_you_do: High school interns can work as Gallery Helpers. They greet visitors and talk with children. Or they can be Summer Camp Assistants. They greet campers, set up activities, supervise playtime and lunch hour.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Interns get high school service credit, a letter of recommendation, training, free parking and museum passes to share.
duration: June to August; at least 25 service hours. Gallery shifts of 2-4 hours, 1-3 times a week; camp assistants commit to a full camp week (Mon-Fri, 8:45 a.m. to 1:45 p.m.)
deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2026 are closed. The 2027 deadline is not posted.

name: C-Tech2: Computers and Technology at Virginia Tech
org: Virginia Tech College of Engineering, Center for Engineering Excellence and Discovery
what_you_do: This is a two-week residential summer program on the Blacksburg campus. You live on campus. It includes a biomedical engineering design project. You also learn about other engineering fields. You get a look at college life.
pay_detail: $2,500 for two weeks, covering all expenses except travel and personal items. Full and partial need-based scholarships are available.
duration: 2 weeks, residential (Jun 28 to Jul 11 in 2026)
deadline_text: Page says applications for Summer 2027 open in early December 2026. No closing date posted.

name: College of Science Summer Camps (Explore Science camps)
what_you_do: These are week-long residential science camps. They have hands-on labs and experiments. In 2026, high school camps were Explore Science for rising 9th and 10th graders. Explore Life Science and Explore Physical Science were for rising 11th and 12th graders.
grades: Rising 9th to 12th (Explore Science 9-10; Life and Physical Science camps 11-12)
pay_detail: 2026 price $1,150 per residential camp ($700 for the day camp for rising 7th-8th). Camp fees cover instruction, supplies, room and board; need-based scholarships are available in the application.
duration: 5 days (Sunday to Thursday)
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application portal opened January 2026; deadline for first round of applications March 2. Offers of admission and scholarships made by March 16; accepted campers have until March 30 to pay fees (minus scholarships).

name: Watford Engineering Experience at Virginia Tech (WEE VT)
org: Virginia Tech College of Engineering, Center for Engineering Excellence and Discovery
what_you_do: This is a two-week residential summer program. It is on the Blacksburg campus. You do hands-on engineering activities. Faculty give talks. You also get college application sessions.
pay_detail: $2,500 for two weeks, covering all expenses except travel and personal items. Full and partial need-based scholarships are available.
duration: 2 weeks, residential (Jul 12 to Jul 25 in 2026)
deadline_text: Page says applications for Summer 2027 open in early December. No closing date posted. 2026 program ran Jul 12 to Jul 25, 2026.

name: VASTS: Virginia Aerospace Science and Technology Scholars
org: Virginia Space Grant Consortium with NASA Langley Research Center
city: Hampton, VA (online course, summer academy at NASA Langley)
what_you_do: Take a free online space and STEM course during the school year. Top scholars can be picked for a six-day summer academy at NASA Langley. Teams there design a crewed mission to Mars and meet NASA engineers.
pay_detail: Free. Scholars picked for the summer academy get transportation, housing and meals.
duration: Six online modules from late November, then a 6 day summer academy for selected scholars
deadline_text: The page says apply by October 24, 2026. It also lists online course applications as open August 15 to October 25 (a different date), so apply by October 24 to be safe.

name: Virtual Enterprises International
what_you_do: You can take a class where you run a simulated business. The class has trade shows and competitions. It ends with a Youth Business Summit.
pay_detail: School/district pays (cost not public)
duration: School year
deadline_text: Depends on your school.

name: WakeMed Junior Volunteer Program (High School)
what_you_do: High school students volunteer one set day each week. They serve at a WakeMed campus for at least six months. Openings are competitive. They are posted only when positions are open.
grades: High school, through the summer after graduation
duration: Minimum 6 months, one day a week on a regular set day and time
deadline_text: Applications open for only about 24 to 48 hours. The page tells students to check on the 15th of October, December, February, April, June and August. The next check date is October 15, 2026. Both applications were listed as closed on 2026-10-09.

grades: Volunteers: middle and high school students. TAG: grades 7 to 12.
duration: Weekly assignments or one-time tasks. TAG meets monthly.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The library tries to help students who need school service hours, with advance notice.
name: Student Volunteers and Teen Advisory Group (TAG)
what_you_do: Volunteer on weekly or one-time tasks. These include office work, processing new materials and helping in a computer class. You also keep the picture book room neat. TAG members help shape teen programs and meet once a month.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Completed applications are held for six months. Volunteer openings are limited.

name: Washington 4-H
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club and pick one or more projects. Meet regularly. Clubs are led by elected youth officers. They take part in service learning, community outreach and other activities.
pay_detail: The statewide Join page does not list fees. Fees may be set by county, so ask your local Extension office.
duration: One 4-H year. Enrollment opens each Oct. 1.
deadline_text: Enrollment opens on October 1 each year. The statewide Join page gives no closing date.

name: Washington Aerospace Scholars
city: Seattle, WA (online course, then a summer residency at the Museum of Flight)
what_you_do: This is a free online course on air and space vehicle design. It is a UW college course. It runs from November to March. Then there is an optional six-day summer residency. You design a Mars mission with industry mentors.
pay_detail: Phase 1 online course is free (optional 5 UW credits cost $255; financial assistance up to 100% available). Optional Phase 2 six-day residency costs $1,850 including room and board; tuition assistance up to 100% available.
duration: Phase 1: November through March (15-20 hours per two-week lesson). Phase 2: six-day residency in July or August.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications are open and close after October 13, 2026. Applicants are accepted on a rolling basis while room is available.

name: Washington DECA (high school)
org: Washington DECA, chartered association of DECA Inc.
what_you_do: Join your school's DECA chapter. You take a business or marketing class while in it. DECA supports local chapters. It runs a yearly state career development conference.
pay_detail: Student membership is $20 total: $12 to the state association and $8 to DECA Inc. Chapters may add local costs.
duration: School year
deadline_text: Membership deadlines come from your chapter advisor. The 2027 state conference is Feb 25 to 27, 2027 at the Meydenbauer Center in Bellevue.

name: Evergreen Boys & Girls State
what_you_do: Spend a week at Warm Beach Conference Center running a mock city, county and state government. You join a party, hold an office, run elections and make laws.
pay_detail: The program is valued at $700 with meals and housing. A local American Legion Post can sponsor a student for $350 on request, and help for the full $700 is available on request. The site says cost is not a barrier.
duration: One week. 2027 session: Sunday June 20 to Saturday June 26, 2027.
deadline_text: No application deadline is posted. Spaces are limited each year, so apply early. The session is June 20 to 26, 2027.

name: Washington Health (Fremont) High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You can apply to volunteer in hospital roles at Washington Hospital in Fremont. You are a high school student. Openings depend on what the hospital needs.
deadline_text: Next high school round is Fall 2026. The waiting list closed May 22, 2026, but new students can still join and are contacted only when an info session is scheduled.

name: Washington State Legislature Page Program (Senate and House)
what_you_do: Serve for one week at the State Capitol during the legislative session. You hand out materials and deliver messages. You carry the flags at the start of each day's session. You work on the chamber floor and attend Page School.
pay_detail: Stipend of $67 per day. You need a Social Security card to get it. Pages without one can still take part but get no daily stipend.
duration: One week during the session. The 2027 session runs January through April.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 session open Nov 1, 2026. No closing date is posted.

name: Running Start
org: Washington State Board for Community and Technical Colleges
what_you_do: 11th and 12th graders take college classes at a Washington community or technical college. They earn high school and college credit.
pay_detail: No tuition. Students and families pay mandatory fees, books and transportation.
duration: Per quarter or semester
deadline_text: Deadlines are not stated on the SBCTC page; they vary by college.

name: Civil Air Patrol Cadet Program, Washington Wing
city: Statewide, WA (squadrons in Seattle, Yakima, Arlington and more)
what_you_do: Join a local squadron to learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. The Washington Wing lists a cadet competition and a cadet ball. It also lists an encampment. A ground search and rescue academy is listed too.
pay_detail: National Civil Air Patrol page: annual dues of $25 to $50 depending on location, and about $300 to $600 in costs in the first year, less any financial assistance. Ask your squadron for exact costs.
duration: The national page describes about a 2-hour squadron meeting each week, a monthly Saturday event and a week-long summer encampment. School-based squadrons may differ.
deadline_text: Join any time through a local squadron.

name: Washington Youth ChalleNGe Academy
what_you_do: Live on campus in Bremerton for about five months in a free program for teens who have dropped out of high school or are at risk of it. You work on getting school credits back and on life skills.
pay_detail: Free. The page calls it a free life intervention and credit retrieval program.
duration: 22 weeks on campus (a 147-day class cycle), then a two-year follow-up phase
deadline_text: Applications are open for the class that starts Jan 11, 2027. No closing date is posted. Spots go first come, first served.

grades: High school (students stay until they graduate)
duration: Through high school graduation
pay_detail: Free. Federally funded TRIO program. No stipend is mentioned on the pages read.
name: TRIO Upward Bound at Waubonsee Community College
city: Aurora, IL (East and West Aurora High Schools)
what_you_do: Free college prep at school. It includes study hall, tutoring, workshops and college visits. You get help with applications. You also explore careers and get internship chances. There is an optional 6 week summer program at the Sugar Grove campus.
deadline_text: The application page still showed 2024-25, with applications opening August 1, 2024. No current deadline is posted.

duration: Year-round, event and project based
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteering
name: Volunteer Opportunities
what_you_do: Help with park clean-up, yearly special events, program help and youth sports coaching. Planting flowers and cleaning up debris and leaves are listed park jobs.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

duration: Not stated
pay_detail: Unpaid. Earn service hours.
name: Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Help put on events for younger kids, prepare supplies for programs and help shape library services. Teen volunteers earn service hours.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. You can also stop by the Youth and Teen Department during library hours.

duration: Flexible. You choose how often. New volunteer orientation takes about 1 hour.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteering
name: Volunteer with Western DuPage Special Recreation Association (age 15 and up)
city: Wheaton and Naperville area, DuPage County, IL
what_you_do: Help run recreation programs and events for people with disabilities. These include games, art, field trips and one-time events. You can volunteer in a seasonal program, at one event or in the office.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted all year. WDSRA keeps your application on file until a fitting role opens.

name: Wellstar Cobb Medical Center VolunTeen Program
org: Wellstar Health System, Cobb Medical Center
what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital one weekday shift a week over the summer. Tasks include helping guests, moving patients and helping people find their way. You can work in clinical or non-clinical departments.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer role (16 service hours validated)
duration: June 4 to July 29 in 2026, one 4-hour shift a week plus a 2-hour orientation
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application deadline Mar 31, 2026, interviews in March or April, program June 4 to July 29, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Wellstar Kennestone Hospital VolunTeen Program
what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital over the summer. Tasks include customer service, moving patients and helping people find their way. You can work in clinical and non-clinical departments. It is one 2-hour shift a week for 6 of the 8 weeks.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer role. The page mentions no fees.
duration: 8-week summer session in June and July, one 2-hour shift a week for 6 of the 8 weeks
deadline_text: Application window Feb 1 to 15, forms due Feb 28. The page does not print a year, so treat this as the yearly pattern and check for 2027.

name: VolunTeens at Wellstar North Fulton Hospital
org: Wellstar Health System, North Fulton Hospital (Roswell)
what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital over the summer. You work one two-hour shift each week for six of the eight summer weeks.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer role
duration: Summer session in June and July: one two-hour shift per week for six of the eight weeks
deadline_text: Applications open each February, interviews in March, orientation in April. The page does not give a 2027 closing date.

name: Teen Heroes
org: City of West Sacramento Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: You help staff at city summer camps with set up, clean up, crafts, activities and special events. It is a summer mentoring and volunteer program.
pay_detail: Free to join, unpaid. The page does not list a stipend.
deadline_text: Not stated on the page. Dates for the next summer are not posted.

name: West Valley College Concurrent Enrollment
what_you_do: Students in grades 9 to 12 take West Valley College classes for free. Middle College and on-campus dual enrollment exist for some districts.
pay_detail: Free (per the college page)
deadline_text: No deadline on the page. Follow the college's term dates.

duration: School year volunteering begins the week of Monday, September 14 (no year printed; the weekday matches 2026)
pay_detail: Unpaid. Teens earn service hours.
name: Teen Volunteers and Teen Library Council
what_you_do: Help in the Digital Creator Lab, run D&D games, shelve books and decorate Teenspace. You also help at programs. The Teen Library Council plans programs and recommends books. Teens help plan a Haunted Activity House for kids and families on October 30.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. School year volunteering begins the week of Monday, September 14 (no year printed; the weekday matches 2026). Haunted House planning meetings start in spring.

name: Wikipedia Editing
what_you_do: Anyone can edit Wikipedia, even without an account. Start with small fixes and use the tutorials.
pay_detail: Free
duration: Whenever you want
deadline_text: Always open.

grades: Teens in grades 9 to 12. Kids ages 11 to 13 may apply as library helpers with a parent's approval.
duration: School year positions, plus summer positions that run June to August
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteering
name: Teen Volunteer Program (school year and summer)
what_you_do: Help with youth programs and prepare program materials. Write book reviews and make social media posts. In summer, work the Summer Reading Club booth or the Studio maker space. You help patrons with arts, crafts and tech.
deadline_text: Applications for school year teen volunteers were open when read (October 2026). Summer 2026 applications closed for the season. 2027 summer dates are not posted yet.

name: Badger Boys State
org: American Legion, Department of Wisconsin (Badger Boys State)
what_you_do: Spend a week at UW-Eau Claire as a citizen of a mock city and county. Elect city, county and state officials and run the government.
pay_detail: The program says it is 100% funded by donations. A student fee is not stated on the pages read.
duration: One week, June 13 to 19, 2027
deadline_text: The 2027 session is June 13 to 19, 2027 at UW-Eau Claire. No application deadline is posted.

name: Badger Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Wisconsin
what_you_do: Spend a week at UW-Oshkosh in a hands-on program about how government works. Delegates are young women in their junior year of high school.
pay_detail: The American Legion Auxiliary and Legion family sponsor and pay the tuition for a delegate. Clubs, businesses and school groups can also pay. The amount is not stated.
duration: One week, June 20 to 25, 2027
deadline_text: The 2027 session is June 20 to 25, 2027 at UW-Oshkosh. No application deadline is posted.

name: Wisconsin DECA chapters and state conference
org: Wisconsin DECA (chartered association of DECA Inc.)
what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter at your school and build business and marketing skills. Chapters compete at the Wisconsin state conference in Lake Geneva.
pay_detail: $18 per student member: $10 to the state association plus $8 to DECA Inc. Local chapter fees are not stated.
duration: School year
deadline_text: The Wisconsin DECA conference is February 22 to 24, 2027 in Lake Geneva, WI. No membership deadline is posted.

name: Wisconsin Youth Conservation Congress
org: Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources with the Wisconsin Conservation Congress
what_you_do: Join a youth group tied to Wisconsin's citizen conservation panel. You get a mentor. You volunteer with DNR staff, such as on fish and wildlife surveys. You learn how natural resource policy is made.
pay_detail: No pay. Free to join, apart from your own travel costs.
duration: Year-round. Two district meetings plus Spring Hearings and a May convention, with extra field days.
deadline_text: No deadline. The FAQ says applications are accepted and reviewed on an ongoing basis.

name: Wisconsin Youth Apprenticeship
city: Statewide, Wisconsin (run through local regional coordinators)
what_you_do: Work a paid job in a career field you pick. You also take related classes. When you finish, you earn a state Certificate of Occupational Proficiency.
pay_detail: You earn a paycheck from day one. The pay rate is not stated on the page.
duration: Not stated on the pages read. Work and classes run during high school.
deadline_text: The 2025-26 DWD calendar lists March 1, 2026 as the YA enrollment deadline for grant funding. 2026-27 student deadlines are not posted there. Ask your regional coordinator.

name: Wisconsin FFA membership through your school ag class
what_you_do: Join FFA through your school's agriculture program. FFA members build leadership and career skills and can go to events like the state convention.
pay_detail: Traditional membership is $15 total ($8 state, $7 national). Local chapters may charge more. Affiliation program fees depend on enrollment and are paid by the school.
duration: School year
deadline_text: No membership deadline is posted.

name: Civil Air Patrol cadets, Wisconsin Wing
what_you_do: Join a cadet squadron near you. The Wisconsin Wing site lists programs like summer encampment, a wing conference and Legislative Day. Activity details are not on the pages read.
pay_detail: Dues and fees are not stated on the pages read. Ask the squadron.
duration: Year-round
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time.

name: Wisconsin YMCA Youth in Government
city: Madison, WI (Model Government), delegations across Wisconsin
what_you_do: Join a delegation and take on a role in a student model government. Write bills, argue court cases or produce media. Or run for Youth Governor. Then meet at Model Government in Madison.
pay_detail: Dues and conference fees are not listed on the page read. Ask your delegation.
duration: Fall to March: prep, a Pre-Gov session, then the Model Government conference
deadline_text: 2026-27: Judicial, Media and Senate registration closes November 18, 2026. Assembly registration closes December 9, 2026. Pre-Gov is January 30, 2027. Model Government is March 5 to 7, 2027.

name: Woodland Community College Dual Enrollment (Yolo Community College District)
what_you_do: You can take free college classes as a high school student. Some are at partner high schools. Eleven schools offer them, including Woodland, Pioneer and Winters. Others are online or on campus.
pay_detail: Free up to 11 units ($46 per unit fee waived); books may cost
duration: Per term
deadline_text: Rolling by term.

name: Teens Helping Seniors
what_you_do: Teens earn school community service credit. They serve seniors in Woodland.
deadline_text: No dates on the Teen Programs page.

duration: Event based. Hours depend on the event length.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Library staff give letters with the service hours earned.
name: Teen Volunteers and Book Reviews for Service Hours
what_you_do: Help with library tasks at scheduled events, like prepping crafts, pulling materials and cleaning. Or write a book review and get one hour of service for each review.
deadline_text: No deadline. Register for each volunteering event on the volunteering calendar. Reviews can be submitted once a month.

name: work2future Young Adult Program
what_you_do: You can get career advising and job readiness workshops. You can get paid work experience. You can also connect with employers in Santa Clara County.
pay_detail: Paid work experience; the page says earn up to $25 an hour. Other services are free.
deadline_text: Enrollment is open year-round.

name: workNet DuPage Youth Program
what_you_do: Free career help for young adults. It includes one-on-one counseling, resume and interview training, and job placement. You can take job shadows and company tours. You can get paid work at a local worksite. You may get money for training or school.
pay_detail: Paid work experience is offered; pay rates and length are not stated. Training or school help is up to $10,000.
duration: Not stated
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page.

name: Youth R.I.S.E. (Reaching Independence through Skills and Employment)
org: WorkSource Atlanta (City of Atlanta workforce board)
what_you_do: This is free help for Atlanta youth all year. You get paid work experience and internships. You get job readiness workshops. You get GED or high school support. You can take short training that leads to credentials.
pay_detail: Paid work experience and internships are one service. Wage not posted on the page. Services are no cost.
duration: Year-round, no set end date
deadline_text: Year-round, first come first served. After the online orientation you have 30 days to submit all documents or your application may be closed.

name: WorkSource DeKalb Youth Services (WIOA)
what_you_do: Career planning, help finishing high school or a GED, skills training and a paid work experience placement, with a mentor and job placement help. Free.
pay_detail: $13 per hour for paid work experience, up to 14 weeks. Up to $250 more in milestone rewards. Free to join.
duration: Paid work experience up to 14 weeks
deadline_text: No deadline is listed.

name: WorkSource Fulton Youth Services
what_you_do: This is year-round job readiness training. It includes GED and high school diploma help. You can get paid work experience and transportation help. You also get occupational skills training. It is for Fulton County youth.
pay_detail: Paid work experience is one service. Wage not posted on the page.
duration: Year-round
deadline_text: Year-round. No application dates are posted.

name: West Sacramento Home Run Paid Summer Internships
org: West Sacramento Home Run and City of West Sacramento
what_you_do: Apply and interview for a paid summer internship with a local employer. The Home Run team gives work readiness training and the city pays you.
pay_detail: Paid by the City of West Sacramento, up to 40 hours per week. Hourly rate not posted on the page.
duration: summer, up to 40 hours per week
deadline_text: The 2026 Internship Calendar is an image on the page (not readable here). 2027 dates not posted yet.

name: STEAM@XU Research Immersion (summer pre-college)
what_you_do: Spend one week on campus doing a hands-on research project led by Xavier faculty, with college readiness workshops. Choose a day camp or a residential stay.
pay_detail: 2026 prices: day camp $495 ($545 after May 1, 2026); residential $1,095 ($1,195 after May 1, 2026). Scholarships offered.
duration: 1 week (2026: July 19/20 to 24)
deadline_text: The page shows 2026 dates and prices under a 2027 title. The Summer Programs page says 2027 programs are being finalized and that 2027 scholarship applications are open.

name: YCOE Work-Based Learning (B-Unbound)
what_you_do: You pick a career interest. Yolo County Office of Education staff match you with a vetted mentor. The mentor works at a business, agency or nonprofit. You complete about 60 hours of hands-on learning.
pay_detail: Stipend up to $500 on successful completion
duration: About 60 hours
deadline_text: Rolling; no posted deadline.

name: Youth Employment Partnership (YEP) summer and afterschool jobs
what_you_do: You can get paid job training and work placements in Oakland. Summer programs include Oakland Summer Rising, Team Oakland and Career Try-Out. There are also afterschool jobs.
pay_detail: Paid; about 100 hours of work in the City summer program (hourly rate not posted)
duration: Summer: about 100 hours, June 1 to Sept 30 (City list). Afterschool jobs during the school year.
deadline_text: No closing dates posted. YEP lists an Afterschool Job Application and a Young Adult Program Application 2026.

name: Teen Leaders Club and Changemakers
what_you_do: Join Leaders Club or Changemakers. In Leaders Club, teens lead projects, plan events, do service projects, and connect with mentors. It can include travel to conferences. In Changemakers, teens work on causes they care about, with advocacy and public speaking.
pay_detail: Clubs are free for teens who are Y members. Financial help is available. The page does not give membership prices.
duration: Leaders Club meets weekly. Changemakers meeting schedule and season length not stated.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Register on the Y site or at your local branch.

name: YMCA of Orange County Volunteer Opportunities
city: Fullerton, Huntington Beach, Newport Beach, Laguna Niguel, Mission Viejo (YMCA branches), CA
what_you_do: You can help at YMCA special events at age 14 and up. Events include golf tournaments and 5K races. At 16 and up, you can take an ongoing role. Roles include tutor, sports volunteer and Kids Zone helper.
pay_detail: Unpaid
duration: Varies by role
deadline_text: No dates listed. Special-event volunteering is seasonal, so the page says to stay tuned.

name: YMCA of San Francisco Workforce Development (Teens)
what_you_do: Teens 14 and older build job skills. They get job readiness training. They can earn certifications. They may get paid internships and job placements. What is offered varies by YMCA branch.
pay_detail: Paid internships are mentioned at the Urban Services YMCA. Wage and hours are not stated. Other activities are not described as paid.
deadline_text: Not stated on the page.

name: Outdoor Science School Cabin Leader (Camp Campbell)
what_you_do: Teens mentor students during five-day outdoor science school sessions in the redwoods. They guide activities. They help keep camp safe and fun. Leaders get a full day of training before students arrive.
pay_detail: Pay not stated. The page says this is a way to earn Service-Learning credit for graduation.
duration: Five days per session (typically Monday to Friday). Session dates are not stated.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 school year open in August and close in the middle of May. The exact closing date is not stated.

name: YMCA Leaders Club (Middle and High School)
city: Chapel Hill and the Triangle, NC
what_you_do: This is a year-long leadership and community service club for teens. It meets at local YMCA branches. Members get leadership training. They volunteer with Y programs.
grades: 6-12 (Middle School Leaders Club grades 6-8; High School Leaders Club grades 9-12)
pay_detail: 2026-27 dues: $240 per year (Member) or $301 per year (Participant); club dues only, not annual events
duration: Early fall to the end of the school year
deadline_text: No registration deadline stated. Clubs start in early fall; A.E. Finley YMCA held interest meetings September 15 and 16, 2026.

name: Lightner Y Achievers
what_you_do: Teens meet in small groups. They explore education and career options. They do community service. They take college and industry tours. High school students tour universities each spring break.
pay_detail: $217 per year (Members) or $228 per year (Participants). Financial assistance is available through a separate form.
duration: Biweekly Saturday summits, 10 a.m. to 1 p.m., September 2026 to May 2027
deadline_text: No application or registration deadline stated. College tour registration opens in early 2027.

name: YMCA Youth and Government (Model Legislature and Court)
what_you_do: You go to weekly local meetings. At in-person conferences in November and February, you act as a lawmaker, lawyer or judge.
pay_detail: The fee is not posted on either page I read; ask your local YMCA about cost and scholarships
duration: Weekly meetings plus conferences in November and February
deadline_text: Sign-up dates are not stated on the page. A conference is planned for November, so ask now.

name: Yolo County 4-H Youth Development Program
org: UC Agriculture and Natural Resources, Yolo County 4-H
what_you_do: Join a community 4-H club. You do hands-on projects in animals, agriculture, arts and science. You can take part in events and leadership roles.
pay_detail: 2026-27 enrollment is $80 per youth (waiver or reduction available).
deadline_text: 2026-2027 enrollment fee posted ($80). No closing date stated; join through a local club.

name: Youth Employment Services (WIOA paid work experience)
what_you_do: You can get paid work experience with a local employer. You can also get help with job searches, resumes and interviews. You can get help with school or training options.
pay_detail: Paid work experience. The pay rate and number of hours are not stated on the page.
duration: Not stated
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the page. Contact the Workforce Development Program Manager to check eligibility and enrollment.

name: Youth volunteers at Yolo County Library branches
city: Yolo County, CA (West Sacramento, Winters, Esparto, Clarksburg, Yolo and others)
what_you_do: You help library staff at a Yolo County Library branch. Opportunities differ by branch.
deadline_text: No deadline. Applications are accepted at branches.

name: Youth volunteering at Yolo Food Bank
what_you_do: Help the food bank pack food and work at distributions. Volunteers ages 12 to 17 sign a youth waiver with a parent signature.
deadline_text: Sign up for open shifts any time.

name: Youth Community Service (YCS)
city: Palo Alto, CA (serves Palo Alto, East Palo Alto and nearby)
what_you_do: You can take part in service projects. You can join a peer mental health leadership program. There are school programs and a service award. This nonprofit runs them.
grades: Service award is for grades K to 12; Summer of Service is for high school
deadline_text: Ongoing. Service Award cycles run in four windows; the current one is Fall 2026, Sep 1 to Nov 30, 2026.

duration: Paid Work Experience: 10 weeks
pay_detail: Paid Work Experiences: Youth Job Center covers all costs, including salary. The pay rate is not stated on the pages read. Coaching and training are free.
name: Youth Job Center: coaching and Paid Work Experiences
org: Youth Job Center (Evanston, Englewood and Pilsen)
city: Evanston, IL (also Englewood and Pilsen in Chicago)
what_you_do: Get free job coaching, workforce readiness training and job placement. A Paid Work Experience is a 10 week job that is part work and part structured learning, with a chance to be hired for good.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Sign up any time using the interest form.

name: Youth Radio
what_you_do: You can join a youth media group. You learn journalism, audio storytelling and digital content. Editors are your mentors. You keep control of your own stories.
pay_detail: Pay not stated on the site
deadline_text: No dates posted. Youth Radio paused in 2024 and says it is back in 2026.

name: Youth Spirit Artworks job training
what_you_do: You can get arts training and paid jobs if you are a low-income or homeless young person.
pay_detail: Job training rate not posted (checked 2026-10-09). The home page lists a $300 stipend for full participation in some workshop series.
deadline_text: Not posted. The home page FAQ says YSA is not actively accepting applications.

name: Youth UpRising Summer Jobs and Job Readiness
what_you_do: You can get job readiness training. You can also get paid summer jobs or internships in East Oakland. Career and education services are open all year.
pay_detail: Paid (100 hours of fully paid work per the City list); rate not posted
duration: About 100 hours over 4 to 6 weeks (City list)
deadline_text: No dates posted on the site. Contact YU in spring for the next summer.

name: YouthBeat Media Careers and Pre-Apprentice Program
what_you_do: You can get free media training in classrooms and afterschool clubs. Advanced students can join a pre-apprentice program and paid fee-for-service projects at YouthBeat PRO.
pay_detail: Training is free; apprentice and PRO work is paid (rate not posted)
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Use the Apply link on the site.

duration: Yearly award
pay_detail: One $2,000 scholarship each year
name: Youth Leadership Award and Scholarship
what_you_do: Apply for a $2,000 scholarship. It goes to one high school senior who shows leadership and will go on to higher education. The award honors young people who lead with courage, fairness and service.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The 2026 winner was to be announced at the Leader Luncheon on May 14, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted yet.

name: Volunteen Program (Zoo Atlanta)
what_you_do: Serve at the Zoo for a full program year in areas like habitat interpretation, public events, conservation projects, Safari Camp and animal nutrition. Training week is required.
pay_detail: Unpaid. $30 orientation fee covers name badge, uniform shirt and access card. Scholarships available for qualified applicants.
duration: June 1 to May 31. At least 160 hours total: 100 in summer, 30 in fall, 30 in spring. Required training week June 7 to 11, 2027.
deadline_text: Applications open 9 a.m. Jan 1 and close 5 p.m. Jan 31 (the page prints no year; it is for the June 2027 program year, so Jan 2027). A free Program Preview is Nov 14, 10 a.m. to noon, with registration.

name: Zooniverse Citizen Science
what_you_do: You help real researchers. You classify images, audio and text. There are hundreds of online projects.
pay_detail: No cost stated on the pages read; it is a volunteer research site
duration: Whenever you want
deadline_text: Always open.
